messages.content: Return only the requested English text. Do not add a preface or word/token count.

Write a practical notice for a fictional seed library: borrowers may take two packets, record the variety, and return seeds after harvest only if they can verify the variety. Aim for approximately 60–85 English tokens.

message.content: Welcome to our Community Seed Library! You are invited to borrow up to two seed packets per visit. Please carefully record the specific variety name in our logbook before leaving. We encourage you to grow, enjoy, and save seeds from your harvest. However, please note that returned seeds are accepted only if you can positively verify the variety’s identity. This ensures genetic integrity for future gardeners. If verification is impossible, kindly share your surplus with neighbors instead. Thank you for helping us maintain a trustworthy, thriving local seed collection for everyone’s benefit.
